# Reviewed inventory of registered POST routes that require forwarded JWT claims.
# Kept static: removing a guard must not silently remove its test case.
# /messaging/callbacks takes the webhook component's relay signature instead
# of claims, and refuses any request without it the same way.
# /locate-ballot also answers a request with no token, for published audited
# ballots only; a token that doesn't verify is refused like everywhere else.
